body:
Redline round 5

Final nit pass: reviewed only round 4's fixes (8bad058..b5e890e) for correctness bugs they introduced.

The round 4 fixes add no correctness bug. The one behaviour change, resumeLine choosing the resolve clause by the stop (R4-4), keys on an error opening with "the resolve agent ". Each of the nine resolveWith checks opens that way (workflows/redline-loop.js lines 3827 to 3923). The autopilot stop at line 3804 and run()'s "returned nothing" crash do not. The marker hands the error back unchanged (line 5180, scripts/redline-prefs.sh line 198), and the new loop-test count pins this. The other changes are a rest-destructuring rewrite of the intake drop with the same behaviour (R4-3), comments and prose that match the code they describe, and two agent-file sentences. The first says an override's fix is a task of its own, as namedUnplanned requires through taskFilesOf. The second keeps an unapplied decision pending on an autopilot resume.

No findings.
